body:
Spec: .adlc/specs/p0-p1-human-interrogation.md (design D1; read the Problem section for why — the doctrine at ADLC.md:207 prescribes grillme-style interrogation, and no flow implements it).

Write a single reference document, `docs/interrogation-protocol.md`, defining the interrogation loop once so the six harness plugins reference it instead of drifting. It must specify:

1. The design-tree frontier model: track open decisions as a tree; each round asks every question whose prerequisites are settled (the frontier), numbered, each with a recommended answer. No one-question-at-a-time drip; no question whose premise depends on an unanswered earlier question.
2. The codebase-check clause: before asking any question, attempt to answer it from the repository; only questions the repo cannot answer reach the human. This is the half of ADLC.md:207 that distinguishes interrogation from a questionnaire.
3. Question sources in priority order: (1) coldstart gaps, (2) parallax divergences, (3) premortem interrogation questions, (4) `.adlc/lessons/interrogation-template.md` checkboxes when present, (5) the interrogator's own frontier.
4. Stopping condition: frontier empty — every branch visited, nothing silently assumed — then a one-screen readback of resolved decisions for confirmation.
5. The parallax re-run cap: 3 rounds maximum, then surviving divergences go to the human one final time as explicit decisions recorded as approved assumptions; the residual divergence score is carried in the spec-approval payload.
6. Transcript handling: resolved Q→A pairs are folded into the ticket body / spec text itself, never a sidecar, so coldstart and spec-lint re-runs see them and downstream agents inherit answers as spec.
7. Harness bindings: Claude Code uses AskUserQuestion; other harnesses use their native prompt affordance; headless/CI contexts skip interrogation and must find the answers already folded into the artifact (which is what the gates check).

Acceptance criteria:
- `test -f docs/interrogation-protocol.md` exits 0.
- The doc names all five question sources: `grep -c -e coldstart -e parallax -e premortem -e interrogation-template docs/interrogation-protocol.md` is ≥ 4.
- The round cap is stated: `grep -qi '3 rounds\|three rounds' docs/interrogation-protocol.md` succeeds.
- `adlc spec-lint .adlc/specs/p0-p1-human-interrogation.md` still exits 0 (spec untouched or kept consistent).
- Full suite green: `npm test` exits 0.
title: Write docs/interrogation-protocol.md: the shared grill-style human interrogation protocol for P0/P1
